# Emerging Markets Finance and Trade

## Identity
- **Abbreviation:** EMFT
- **Publisher:** Taylor & Francis (Routledge)
- **ISSN:** 1540-496X (print, SCImago search string) / 1558-0938 (online, per ResearchGate listing — UNVERIFIED)
- **Homepage:** https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/mree20
- **Author guidelines:** UNVERIFIED (About page: https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/mree20/about-this-journal)

## Scope
Per the T&F About page: emphasises empirical work on emerging markets with significant implications for policymakers, managers, financial institutions, corporations and other stakeholders; theoretical papers welcome only "supported by strong practical applications"; fields include economics, finance, international business and international relations. The journal "does not have any certain country coverage or geographic location preference". SCImago's scope text adds comparisons of emerging with developed/developing economies and policy lessons.

## Scope Keywords
emerging markets, empirical finance, financial markets, contagion, volatility, policy implications, international finance, Asia, single-country emerging-market studies

## Article Types Accepted
- Original research article — other types UNVERIFIED

## Classification
- **Tier:** Q2 in Finance — SCImago SJR 2025 = 0.747; Finance Q2; best quartile Q1 in Economics, Econometrics and Finance (misc.) (scimagojr.com source id 27748 and Finance ranking page)  **Correction (2026-10-10):** SCImago shows SJR 2025 Q1 in Economics, Econometrics and Finance (miscellaneous); best quartile is therefore Q1, above APFM (Q2) and outside the author's Q2–Q3 band.
- **Open Access:** Hybrid (subscription route, no mandatory APC); OA price UNVERIFIED
- **Field:** Emerging-market finance / Economics

## Special Notes
Review speed (T&F About page): 52 days average submission to first decision (includes desk rejections); 18 days acceptance to online publication; acceptance rate 33 % (last full calendar year). AI policy (T&F, issued 12 June 2024): generative AI cannot be an author; authors must include a statement naming the tool and version and explaining how and why it was used, in the Methods or Acknowledgments section.

## Acceptance Signals
- **Selectivity band:** accessible-to-selective (published acceptance rate 33 %)
- **Desk-reject triggers:** work without practical/policy implications; theory without practical application (from aims text)
- **Study-type tolerance:** empirical emerging-market studies; no geographic preference
- **Review process:** peer review; first-decision metric includes desk rejects
- **Cascade / transfer:** T&F finance titles (Quantitative Finance, Investment Analysts Journal); transfer service UNVERIFIED
